capabilities: Render and control Mermaid and ECharts diagrams
Resize and align tables and images, and crop images
Export notes to PDF, Word, PPTX, images and HTML
Add reading, navigation, clipping and template tools
disambiguation: Not the Ignorance theme itself; it is a companion plugin that also works without the theme.
extras: Bundles about 3.6 MB of libraries; Word/PDF import and some exports require desktop; no telemetry.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in Mermaid, recolored to the active theme and palette in light and dark.
problem: Notes need many separate tools to style diagrams and tables, present slides, and export to common formats.

relations.evidence: Works on its own, or together with the Ignorance theme
